rows.name: labels
rows.description: Chrome text — the SkipToContent link label.

rows.name: header
rows.description: Top header band — typically a CompassHeader wrapping a Masthead/brand + nav + profile.

rows.name: children
rows.description: Main content. Wrapped in the focusable SkipToContent target.

rows.name: sidebarStart
rows.description: Left navigation rail (e.g. a vertical Nav).

rows.name: footer
rows.description: Docked footer — the CompassMessageBar slot (search / AI prompt bar).

rows.name: drawer
rows.description: Mobile-nav drawer panel; when set, Compass renders the slide-in drawer.

rows.name: isDrawerOpen
rows.description: Controlled open state for the mobile-nav drawer.

rows.name: onDrawerOpenChange
rows.description: Fired when the drawer requests opening (the masthead hamburger).

rows.name: mainContentId
rows.description: Id for the main-content region (SkipToContent target). Defaults to a generated id.
